data.name: Moutiq
data.long_meaning: One who is in pursuit of knowledge and truth. Derived from the Arabic root ‘awtq’, which means ‘to seek’. In Islamic tradition, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) encouraged continuous learning and exploration of the divine word.
data.spiritual_meaning: May Allah guide and inspire you on your journey of knowledge and righteousness.
data.numerology_meaning: Those with a life path number 3 are creative, artistic, and expressive. They have a natural ability to inspire and bring joy to others.

in_arabic.name: موتق
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من الفعل وتیق یعني من یتیق به و یوثق
in_arabic.long_meaning: الموتق هو اسم من أصل عربي مشتق من الفعل وتیق، وهو يعني الشخص الذي يوثق به و يتيقن بقدرته، و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني الثقة و الاطمئنان في اللغة العربية و الذی یرد في بعض المواضع في القرآن الكريم كصفة للمتقين

in_urdu.name: موتیق
in_urdu.meaning: وہ شخص جس پر بھروسہ کیا جائے اور قابل اعتماد ہو
in_urdu.long_meaning: موتیق ایک عربی मूल کا نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جس پر بھروسہ کیا جائے، قابل اعتماد اور وثوق کا حامل، یہ نام عربی زبان میں ثقة اور یقین کے مفہوم سے ماخوذ ہے، اور اسلامی تقویم میں اس کا استعمال ایک قابل ستائش نام کے طور پر کیا جاتا ہے

in_hindi.name: मौतिक
in_hindi.meaning: जिस पर भरोसा किया जा सके, विश्वासपात्र
in_hindi.long_meaning: मौतिक एक अरबी मूल का नाम है जिसका अर्थ है जिस पर भरोसा किया जा सके, यह नाम विश्वसनीयता और भरोसे के गुण को दर्शाता है, जो इस्लामी नामकरण परंपरा में एक महत्वपूर्ण पहलू है, यह नाम उन लोगों के लिए चुना जाता है जिन पर विश्वास किया जा सके

in_pashto.name: موتیق
in_pashto.meaning: داسي کسے چې پرې یې باوري وي او منل شوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: موتیق د عربي اصلي نوم دی چې معنی یې داسي کسے چې پرې یې باوري وي، منل شوي او د باور وړ کس، په پښتو کلتور کې دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کېږي چې د دوی پر باوري وي

in_english.name: Moutiq

data.cultural_impact: The name "Moutiq" is a reminder of the Islamic emphasis on the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom. Throughout Islamic history, scholars and intellectuals have contributed significantly to various fields of study, including mathematics, engineering, medicine, philosophy, literature, and natural sciences. Unlike other ancient civilizations, Islamic scholars were open to the incorporation of new knowledge from other cultures and traditions, leading to an intellectual exchange that enriched the Islamic world.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Moutiq" also carries profound spiritual significance in the Islamic faith. In the Quran, Allah (God) says, "O you who believe! Seek knowledge by that which Allah hath given you, the faculties of understanding and the intellect (Al Imran, 102)." This verse underscores the importance of intellectual endeavor and reflection in the pursuit of the Divine guidance and, ultimately, the attainment of spiritual enlightenment.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Battuta visited Moutiq during his travels in the 14th century. He described it as a major trading center and a significant Islamic cultural center.
Moutiq was the capital city of the Fatimid Caliphate from 969 to 1171 AD. It was a center of Islamic learning and scholarship during this period.
